The decisions of the Traffic Safety Committee are advisory to the City Council, and the City

September 23, 2014. Interested persons who wish to object to the decision may speak to the
Council with their concerns. As these decisions are typically on the Consent Calendar, the person
must ask the Council during the appropriate time at the beginning of the meeting to “pull” the item
from the Consent Calendar for discussion.

unless it can be demonstrated that the item is of an emergency nature, or the need to take action

minutes_text:
ACTION MEMO
  TRAFFIC SAFETY COMMITTEE
  MEETING

Council Chambers - City Hall  Wednesday
340 Palos Verdes Drive West  September 10, 2014
Palos Verdes Estates, CA 90274  7:30 PM

CALL TO ORDER

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL  Committee Members Beall, King, Leach, Vice-Chair Kao, and Chairman Buss
  present.

COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE PUBLIC
 Norm Zareski (1725 Dalton Road) spoke regarding his concerns over the new state law that
  requires motorists to provide a 3-foot buffer when overtaking bicyclists.

OLD BUSINESS
1. None.

NEW BUSINESS
2. 400-600 Block Palos Verdes Drive West Traffic Control Modification.

  Traffic Safety Committee member Beall moved (seconded by Traffic Safety Committee
  member Leach) to recommend that Staff: 1) Install all immediate improvements per
  Recommendation 1(a-f) as recommended by the City Traffic Engineer; and, 2) Further
  evaluate the potential costs and feasibility of obtaining outside funding for roadway widening
  in the vicinity of 400-600 Palos Verdes Drive West. The vote was 5 in favor.

  Actions taken by this Committee are advisory.
  The City Council will take action on all appropriate items on Tuesday, September 23, 2014.

Traffic Safety Committee  1  Planning & Building Director  SR
Action Memo
September 10, 2014
 3. Lunada Bay Plaza Parking.

  Traffic Safety Committee Vice-Chair Kao moved (seconded by Traffic Safety Committee
  member King) to recommend that Staff: 1) Retain the existing perpendicular parking stall
  layout; and, 2) Coordinate with the businesses to evaluate the existing time limits for parking
  within the Plaza and return to the Committee at a later date with a report identifying any
  appropriate modifications. The vote was 5 in favor.

RESIDENT LETTERS
4. Traffic Conditions on Via Segunda at Via Campesina – Tom Schloemer.

  Action: Chair Buss moved (seconded by Traffic Safety Committee member King) to
  recommend that Staff review traffic conditions and report back to the Committee. The vote
  was 5 in favor.

ITEMS OF INFORMATION FROM STAFF/COMMITTEE

5. July 22, 2014 City Council Action Minutes.
   Item 12 (a) – Palos Verdes Drive West and Yarmouth Road Yield Control Modification
   Item 12 (b) – Palos Verdes Drive West and Paseo Del Mar Parking Lot Traffic Control
  Modifications
   Item 12 (c) – Stop control request at Via Coronel and Via Zurita – Zachary Bazilius

6. Staff Items of Information for the Committee.
  a. City of Torrance Triathlon Event Update
  b. FY 14/15 Street Resurfacing Program Update
  c. Paseo Del Sol Turnaround RFP Update
  d. Street Repair RFP Update
  e. Radar Speed Feedback Sign Purchase Update
  f. Malaga Cove Plaza Parking Study Update

ADJOURNMENT TO OCTOBER 8, 2014.

  Actions taken by this Committee are advisory.
  The City Council will take action on all appropriate items on Tuesday, September 23, 2014.
